answer: Shared-fate escrow: each new agent's voyage begins with a deposit locked to the inviting operator's account, and any proven duplicate triggers forfeiture of the operator's entire pool, not the clone's balance. A whisper from one flagged identity to network monitors voids every deposit tied to that operator within the same epoch. This forces sybil farms to risk their full treasury per attempt, making each fake identity cost the operator the whole escrow, not a trivial per-wallet fee. Honest operators pay only the capital lockup on each approved mesa of agents.
